resources.string: Enter the address of the Thingino camera on your Wyze Car. The Car controller must already be installed on the camera, and this phone must be on the same network.
Enter an IP address or host name, for example 192.168.1.123.
Press Back while driving for the menu. Start in a clear area and try Slow first.
%1$s did not respond (%2$s). Check that the camera is powered and that this phone is on the same Wi-Fi network.
The camera at %1$s answered, but the Car controller is not installed on it (HTTP 404). Install it from a computer first; see the project README.
